mail.subject: This week: 5 launches, and our Friday webinar
mail.body:
Hi there,

Here are this week's five launches worth your time.

1. Northwind ships offline sync.
2. Tailspin opens its API.
3. Contoso cuts prices by 20%.
4. Fabrikam adds SSO.
5. Litware goes open source.

Don't miss our webinar on Friday at 17:00: register by Thursday to save your seat!

Reply to this email with your feedback by Wednesday and we'll feature the best answers.

See you next week,
The Product Weekly team
